rules.question: does M2's Not established survive one common instrument and a gene-set null
rules.found_by: a five-lens adversarial review of M2, not by this repository
rules.R17_one_instrument: Cebpa leaves the AT2 arm in every well: Etv5, Abca3, Lamp3, Sftpb, Slc34a2, Lyz2, Napsa, Pon1
rules.R18_geneset_null: 300 random gene sets matched gene by gene on distal peak count, evaluated on the real split; their mean replaces the genome-wide median offset
rules.R19_two_nulls: an arm must clear both the cell-permutation sham and the gene-set null at |z| >= 3
rules.R20_shams: 500; the equivalence statement is a confidence interval on the relative scale
rules.R21_no_p_values: a z is a standardised distance; the percentile within each null is reported beside it
rules.may_not_do: resurrect M1e's reading; the arm is consistently negative under every weighting
